purpose: Review all 15 fixed L1 condition archives, diagnose recorded failures and specify the next narrowly scoped experiment.
required_work: Verify referenced archive/checkpoint/revision provenance; distinguish historical flat evidence, uphill diagnostic repeats and latest fixed-condition results.
Build a comparable table of completion, steps, speed error, signed drift, yaw, posture, foot slip, safety termination and diagnostic completeness.
Replay existing boundary traces on CPU and compare slope/rough-slope failures descriptively; do not claim causal mechanisms from unequal geometry/state seeds.
Audit all three friction layouts for actual per-foot coverage and unavailable material readback; document evidence gaps.
Produce a concrete minimal follow-up proposal with frozen inputs, scope, acceptance, resources and stop rules. Any runtime, controller/policy/safety change or training requires separate approval.
Commit, push, verify remote SHA, report and stop.
exclusions: No changes to controller, rewards, physics or safety thresholds
reason: All 15 fixed conditions now have evidence, but recorded failures prevent all-condition qualification. Review existing evidence before proposing new execution.
authorization_rule: The current approval covers only the completed alternating-regions phase. This offline synthesis is proposed for the next separately approved phase.
